title: Autonomous Delivery Drone with Modular Payload System
abstract: A multi-rotor delivery drone with 25kg payload, 80km range, automated payload exchange, redundant 8-motor propulsion, LiDAR obstacle avoidance.
claims: Octocopter with 8 independent motors providing flight with up to 2 motor failures.
Modular payload bay with automated locking for 30x30x30cm containers max 25kg.
Navigation combining RTK-GPS (2cm), LiDAR (200m), stereo vision.
problem_statement: Last-mile delivery is 53% of shipping costs. Drones reduce delivery from hours to minutes.
